scopes.meaning: read artifacts in the provider's store
add artifacts to the store (never modify or delete)
read files and package directories inside the read roots the host allows

authority.summary: Discovery grants nothing. The host that starts the provider grants scopes for a session; every invocation checks the scopes its contract names and fails with `unauthorized` listing the missing ones. No capability acts at a source system.

notes: deterministic given the same providers, store and readers

capabilities.description: Inputs the profile does not accept are inspected by content, reused if an artifact for the same bytes exists, otherwise ingested, read by a vision.read provider when one is authorized, annotated as inference, and projected within the profile's context budget. The instruction is returned unchanged as the first content item.
guarantees: the instruction is the first content item, unchanged
inferred content is marked !inferred; content no provider could read is declared unknown
nothing is sent to any model

now.description: ISO 8601 time for captures; defaults to the host clock

modes.note: every content part is text; the record comes as structured data

select.model: a profile that accepts only text

outcomes: make an image readable by a text-only model
convert an attachment for a model that cannot read it
the model does not support images
prepare a model request from a screenshot
preconditions: each transformation step needs its own provider's scopes (store:write to ingest, vision:read to read); missing ones are reported per step, not escalated
capabilities.summary: Given an instruction, inputs and a model capability profile, return content that model can consume: accepted inputs as-is, others as provenance-preserving text representations, with a decision record.
capabilities.title: Adapt inputs to a model's input modalities

notes: contract ids name capabilities, not this provider; minor versions only add optional fields
unknown input fields are rejected, unknown output fields must be ignored
no clock except the host-supplied capture time

interfaces.description: `xeet engine mcp`: progressive tools (engine_discover, engine_describe, engine_invoke) by default, every capability as a tool with --tools all; artifacts as resources
`xeet engine manifest | discover | describe | call <capability> --input JSON`

limitations: reads content only through providers that declare vision.read; without one, an image's content is reported as unknown
ingests images only (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP); other modalities are reported as not deliverable

nonCapabilities.alternative: inject modality.adapt's content into your own model request (or use xeet-gateway's Gateway::run in Rust with your ModelClient)
outcomes: send a request to a model
nonCapabilities.why: the gateway prepares content; sending it is the runtime's model client's job

provider.description: Prepares inputs for a model whose input modalities are stated in a profile: passes through what it accepts, represents the rest as text through other providers' contracts, and records why.
provider.name: xeet modality gateway
